name: RHD prophylaxis overdue
description: BPG injection past due: last injection plus the regimen interval has passed
criteria: SELECT pat.patient_id FROM (SELECT o.person_id, MAX(o.value_datetime) AS last_injection FROM obs o JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE c.uuid = '183fb30e-b861-5b7c-806f-7118a40f2b51' AND o.voided = 0 GROUP BY o.person_id) inj JOIN (SELECT o.person_id, CASE rt.code WHEN 'q14_day_bpg' THEN 14 WHEN 'q21_day_bpg' THEN 21 WHEN 'q28_day_bpg' THEN 28 END AS interval_days FROM obs o JOIN concept q ON q.concept_id = o.concept_id JOIN concept_reference_map m ON m.concept_id = o.value_coded JOIN concept_reference_term rt ON rt.concept_reference_term_id = m.concept_reference_term_id WHERE q.uuid = '668e0221-8b41-5669-9ad8-78e193d42494' AND o.voided = 0 AND rt.code IN ('q14_day_bpg','q21_day_bpg','q28_day_bpg')) reg ON reg.person_id = inj.person_id JOIN patient pat ON pat.patient_id = inj.person_id AND pat.voided = 0 WHERE DATE(inj.last_injection) + INTERVAL reg.interval_days DAY < CURDATE()

name: RHD lost to follow-up
description: No RHD consultation and no prophylaxis record for 210 days (7 months) in a patient with a prescription. Mirrors ACT 2.0 Needs Prophylaxis Data Red.
criteria: SELECT pat.patient_id FROM patient pat JOIN (SELECT e.patient_id, MAX(e.encounter_datetime) AS last_consult FROM encounter e JOIN encounter_type et ON et.encounter_type_id = e.encounter_type WHERE et.name = 'RHD Consultation Visit' AND e.voided = 0 GROUP BY e.patient_id) con ON con.patient_id = pat.patient_id JOIN (SELECT o.person_id, MAX(o.value_datetime) AS last_injection FROM obs o JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE c.uuid = '183fb30e-b861-5b7c-806f-7118a40f2b51' AND o.voided = 0 GROUP BY o.person_id) inj ON inj.person_id = pat.patient_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id FROM obs o JOIN concept q ON q.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE q.uuid = '668e0221-8b41-5669-9ad8-78e193d42494' AND o.voided = 0 AND o.value_coded IS NOT NULL) rx ON rx.person_id = pat.patient_id WHERE pat.voided = 0 AND DATE(con.last_consult) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 210 DAY) AND DATE(inj.last_injection) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 210 DAY)
message: Lost to follow-up: no data for 7 months

name: RHD prophylaxis not prescribed
description: Patient has an RHD or acute rheumatic fever diagnosis but no secondary antibiotic prophylaxis recorded. ACT 2.0 rule 1.
criteria: SELECT pat.patient_id FROM patient pat JOIN obs dx ON dx.person_id = pat.patient_id AND dx.voided = 0 AND dx.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '1a5aa050-661d-5e89-95d7-c1eba476df22') JOIN concept_name dxn ON dxn.concept_id = dx.value_coded AND dxn.voided = 0 AND dxn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' LEFT JOIN obs sap ON sap.person_id = pat.patient_id AND sap.voided = 0 AND sap.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '668e0221-8b41-5669-9ad8-78e193d42494') WHERE pat.voided = 0 AND sap.obs_id IS NULL AND dxn.name IN ('RHD A','RHD B','RHD C','RHD D','Acute rheumatic fever')
message: RHD or ARF diagnosis requires prophylaxis

name: RHD 30-day follow-up due
description: Discharged more than 30 days ago with no follow-up contact recorded on that encounter. ACT 2.0 rule 4. Time-based: needs scheduled re-evaluation.
criteria: SELECT pat.patient_id FROM patient pat JOIN obs dis ON dis.person_id = pat.patient_id AND dis.voided = 0 AND dis.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'd4317b82-5d37-5b59-ac32-4922f18cd65b') LEFT JOIN obs fu ON fu.encounter_id = dis.encounter_id AND fu.voided = 0 AND fu.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '49f9238d-2ca4-5efd-a5cb-f00a0b44828d') WHERE pat.voided = 0 AND fu.obs_id IS NULL AND DATE(dis.value_datetime) + INTERVAL 30 DAY < CURDATE()
